## Purpose

Describe the page or content change and the decision it supports.

## Evidence and permissions

- [ ] Every performance claim has a source reference and measurement period.
- [ ] Client names, assets and results have the required permission.
- [ ] No confidential data, credentials or personal data are included.

## Editorial review

- [ ] Brand voice and audience fit reviewed.
- [ ] Facts and links checked against primary sources.
- [ ] SEO title, description and internal links reviewed.
- [ ] English, Chinese or Bahasa Melayu expression reviewed by a fluent human where applicable.

## Product quality

- [ ] Mobile layout checked.
- [ ] Keyboard and reduced-motion behaviour checked.
- [ ] `pnpm content:check` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes.
